If you’re looking for a **blue Staffordshire Bull Terrier (“blue Staffy”) puppy near Liverpool**, start with breeder directories rather than buying from the first advert you see. Current listings can change quickly, but there are blue Staffy adverts around Merseyside and nearby areas. Places to look:

- The Royal Kennel Club puppy finder — you can filter for Staffordshire Bull Terriers, location, and health-tested parents. Recent listings have included blue Staffies in the wider Liverpool/Merseyside area. - You can also check local breeders directly; for example, some Liverpool-based Staffy breeders appear in business listings, but verify their credentials independently before committing. [Ravenscroft Staffordshire Bull Terries Puppies](https://ukstaffypups.uk/) Staffy Puppy Heaven

## Questions to ask the breeder

### Health and genetics

- “Have both parents been health tested? Can I see the certificates?”
- “Have the parents been tested for Staffordshire Bull Terrier conditions such as:

 - L-2-HGA (L-2-hydroxyglutaric aciduria)
- HC (hereditary cataracts/JHC)”
- “Do either parent have breathing, skin, allergy, joint, or temperament issues?”
- “Can I see the mother (dam) with the puppies?”

### About the puppy

- “How old is the puppy, and when can it legally leave?”
- “Has it been microchipped, wormed, vaccinated, and vet checked?”
- “What food is it eating?”
- “What socialisation has it had (children, visitors, household noises, other dogs)?”

### About the breeder

- “How many litters do you breed each year?”
- “Why did you choose this pairing?”
- “Can I visit your home and see where the puppies are raised?”
- “Can I see the puppy’s KC registration details if it is advertised as KC registered?”
- “Will you take the dog back if circumstances change?”

## Things to be cautious about

- A breeder who won’t let you meet the mum.
- Meeting in a car park or being offered delivery only.
- Multiple breeds/lots of puppies always available.
- Pressure to pay a deposit immediately.
- Very high prices justified only by the colour “blue” — colour alone does not indicate health or quality.

A good breeder should be interested in **you and the home you’ll provide**, not just taking payment.

If you tell me your **maximum travel distance from Liverpool** (for example 30, 50, or 100 miles) and whether you want **KC registered only**, I can help narrow the search.
